plans.idea: Classic left-to-right banner read: brand logo, then the book cover, then a wide headline block, ending in the 'Become a Member' button with the price line tucked directly beneath it, as in the original.

Product-led: the book cover anchors the left edge, the headline and benefit copy take the wide centre, and a right-hand column groups the remaining small copy, with the logo stacked over the button as a brand sign-off.

Message-first: logo then the headline right after it on the left, the supporting perks in the middle, and the book cover placed right beside the button at the right end so the product and the action read as one closing pair.
